pick.headline: Bush and Gorbachev meet in Madrid
pick.summary: On October 29, 1991, George Bush and Mikhail Gorbachev met in Madrid on the eve of the Middle East peace conference they co-sponsored.
pick.significance: It was their last summit; Gorbachev's government was disintegrating after the failed August coup and the USSR ended two months later.
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of October 29, 1991, carried Moscow TASS in English previewing the Madrid summit: Churkin said Bush and Gorbachev would focus on nuclear cuts, the Middle East conference, Yugoslavia and Western aid.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 209, 29 October 1991
evidence.snippet: …nts Aleksandr Kro- likov and Sergey Nikishov] [Text] Moscow October 28 TASS—The Soviet Foreign Ministry’s spokesman Vitaliy Churkin told a briefing here today about the program of Soviet President Gor- bachev’s visit to Madrid, which begins today. Gorbachev will attend the opening ceremony of the peace conference on the Middle East and have several bilateral meetings. A meeting between Gorbachev and Bush, scheduled for October 29, is expected…
